responsibility: Provides the umbrella pass definitions and miscellaneous utilities for the tree SSA loop optimizer pipeline. It defines the gate and scaffolding passes that initialize, group, and finalize loop optimizations (including OpenACC loop pass groups), frees loop iteration and scalar-evolution metadata at pipeline end, and exports small shared helpers such as for_each_index, temporary-name generation for loop store motion, and loop instruction-count estimation used by other loop transformation files.
same_name_distinction: Provides the top-level tree-SSA loop pass scaffolding and miscellaneous shared utilities, such as loop pass gates/groups, pipeline finalization, for_each_index, loop-store-motion temp naming, and loop instruction counting. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-loop.h, it defines pass objects and utility function bodies rather than the core loop-analysis data types and declarations.
